item.name: Validate one EU VAT number (VIES)

request.name: Validate one EU VAT number (VIES)

description.content: Check whether an EU VAT number (with country prefix, e.g. IE6388047V, DE811193231, HU33119856) is valid in the official VIES system (EU-27 + XI Northern Ireland). UK (GB) VAT checks are coming soon: until HMRC live access is granted, GB numbers return `status: member_state_unavailable`, `valid: null`, `error: HMRC_LIVE_ACCESS_PENDING` and are not charged. Returns `status` (valid | invalid | invalid_format | member_state_unavailable | error), `valid`, registered `name` and `address` where the member state discloses them, and a `consultation_number` (audit proof) when `requester` is a valid EU VAT. If VIES is down for that member state, `fallback: true` answers come from an official national source (PL Biała lista, CZ ARES, FI YTJ, FR SIRENE) or the last successful VIES result with its date; fallbacks never carry a consultation number. Use for reverse-charge invoicing, customer/supplier onboarding and checkout VAT exemption. Free 20/day per IP, then x402 $0.01.

item.name: Validate an EU e-invoice (EN 16931, XRechnung; UBL, CII, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF)

request.name: Validate an EU e-invoice (EN 16931, XRechnung; UBL, CII, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF)

description.content: Send the invoice as the raw request body (Content-Type application/xml or application/pdf), or JSON {"xml": "..."} / {"base64": "<XML or PDF>"}. Detects UBL Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII (also the XML embedded in a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF), checks the XML schema and the official CEN EN 16931 Schematron rules, plus the KoSIT XRechnung 3.0 rules when the invoice is an XRechnung (or rules=xrechnung). Returns valid true/false and every error with its official rule ID (e.g. BR-CO-10), plain-English message, XPath location, business terms and a fix hint where known. When the seller is Slovak (UBL), it adds Slovak eFaktúra field checks written from the Financial Administration's Peppol BIS transposition v1.12 (0245:DIČ endpoints, addresses, IČO, BT-33, BT-7, VATEX), as warnings with ruleset SK-FS, plus the invoice UUIDv5 cross-check in 'slovakia'. Norwegian sellers (UBL) get W System field checks from Norwegian law (org. no. mod-11, MVA suffix, 'Foretaksregisteret' for AS/ASA/NUF, 0192 endpoints, buyer org. no., VAT rates) as warnings with ruleset NO-LAW and a 'norway' block; not the EHF/Peppol NO-R schematron. Each error has error_class 'format' (XML Schema) or 'business_rule' (Schematron), with format_error_count and business_rule_error_count; for German invoices (seller or buyer DE, XRechnung or ZUGFeRD) 'germany.de_vat_status' says how the BMF letter of 15 Oct 2026 reads the result (a business-rule error without a format error is in principle still an e-invoice for VAT). For French invoices (seller or buyer FR) 'france' checks the supplier and client SIREN the 2026 reform requires (BT-30 / BT-47 with scheme 0002), suggests the SIREN from an FR VAT number when it is missing, and lists the French items it does not check (hint only; French XP Z12-012 rules not run). Peppol BIS 3 specific rules are not checked yet. Technical check, not tax advice. Free tier shared with other endpoints, then x402 $0.03.

Optional: tax_point_date (BT-7), party company_id + company_id_scheme (BT-30/BT-47), seller legal_form (BT-33). Example body: GET /einvoice/sample. Free tier shared, then x402 $0.08.

request.name: "Can I e-invoice this company?" VAT + Peppol + country mandate lookup

description.content: id: an EU VAT number (e.g. BE0403170701) or a Peppol participant id (e.g. 0208:0403170701). Returns the VIES VAT result, whether the company is on Peppol (participant id, BIS 3 invoice/credit note support; Peppol Directory first, then the Peppol SML/SMP lookup Access Points use, so participants without a Directory business card are found too; peppol.source = directory | smp, per-id results in peppol.ids_detail), the country's B2B e-invoice mandate (dates, format, channel, source link) and the recommended format for POST /einvoice/create. NL, EE and LT companies are usually on Peppol under their registry id (0106 KvK, 0191, 0200), not the VAT number: if the VAT-based ids miss, the lookup also tries the registry id found from the VIES name (exact unique match, then a unique match with the legal form such as B.V./UAB ignored) and reports it in peppol.matched_via. Free tier shared, then x402 $0.02.

item.name: SANDBOX: verify buyer -> create -> validate -> route -> transmit (mock or partner Peppol sandbox) -> signed evidence receipt

request.name: SANDBOX: verify buyer -> create -> validate -> route -> transmit (mock or partner Peppol sandbox) -> signed evidence receipt

description.content: One call for the whole e-invoice flow. Body: {"invoice": <same JSON as POST /einvoice/create>, "mode": "sandbox", "transport": "mock"}. Steps: VIES check of buyer.vat_id (invalid VAT stops the flow), sanctions screen of the buyer name, EN 16931 UBL creation + validation (invalid stops the flow), route lookup (Peppol Directory, country mandate, France PPF), transmission via a pluggable transport, and an Ed25519-signed evidence receipt (JWS; public key at GET /einvoice/evidence-key). SANDBOX ONLY. transport: 'mock' (default; transmits nothing), 'recommand' or 'e-invoice-be' (the validated Peppol BIS 3 UBL is really submitted to that Peppol access point's sandbox/playground and the partner document id is returned and signed into the receipt; it is addressed to W System's own sandbox company, never to the buyer, and does not reach the production Peppol network; transmission.transmitted stays false). Partner transports switch invoice.format to peppol-bis3. mode=live sends over production Peppol via e-invoice.be and needs X-API-Key, an active Peppol mandate for invoice.seller.vat_id recorded with that key, W System KYC approval and a provisioned sending account (403 names what is missing); it returns 501 while live sending is switched off. Free tier shared, then x402 $0.08 (same as create).
